title: Kissed Canadian Daikon Hash
description: A rich and crunchy Canadian dish featuring daikon, lardons, and a touch of maple syrup. Perfect for meal prep and a low-fat-friendly option for any meal.
instructions: Heat a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lardons and cook until crispy, about 4 minutes.
Remove the lardons from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the diced daikon to the skillet and cook until slightly tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Return the lardons to the skillet and stir to combine.
Sprinkle the kosher salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the daikon mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley, if desired.
